name: Mike Knott
bio: Mike (Michael) Knott kept a saloon in Medora, beside which John Doulisch was hurt while excavating in March 1884, and in April 1885 the paper, amid complaints about running vagrants out of town, joked that he should be made 'foreman of the stiff-firing gang.' In October 1886 he traded his store building for Tompkins' ranch down the river, planning to farm.

mentions: John Doulisch met with a serious accident yesterday. He was excavating the dirt next to Michael Knott's saloon for a new building, when a number of large lumps fell on him. Joe Pennell and two or three others happened to be passing and stopped on hearing the noise.…
Mike Knott should be appointed to the position of "foreman of the stiff-firing gang."
